experiment: P3o-G bounded posterior-conditioned residual with compound-combination CVaR
research_question: Can a bounded delay-peak residual trained to reduce the worst compound-label group error remove the cross-identity worst-combination instability observed in P3o-E/F, without changing the frozen local time-frequency recognizer?
motivation: P3o-E/F improved average oracle and predicted-gate parameter NMAE but only one of two fresh identity confirmations preserved worst-combination risk. The new mechanism changes neither recognition features nor side-branch capacity; it changes only the parameter objective from a sample mean to an equal-weight upper-tail mean over observed compound-label groups.

identity_protocol.identity_pairing: receiver_noise_seed grouped across every regime and power view

methods.F_base: The selected local STFT plus adjacent-frame phase-increment ParameterMatchedMultiView backbone. It is trained exactly once per seed with BCEWithLogits plus 0.1 masked SmoothL1, selected on early identities, and calibrated only on calibration identities.
methods.G0_bounded_mean: Freeze the complete selected F state, force it to eval mode in every side train call, encode only delay-peak sequences, and add detached-posterior-gated 0.25*tanh residuals. Train with masked per-sample SmoothL1 mean only.
methods.G1_bounded_combo_cvar: Exactly G0 architecture, initialization, data order, optimizer, checkpoints and F state. Add a CVaR term equal to the mean of the largest ceil(25% of present compound-label-group mean losses) in each minibatch. Compound group is the six-label bit mask, computed only from the observed label vector.
methods.causal_scope: G1 can alter parameter predictions only. F parameters, F buffers, F mode, recognition logits, thresholds and predicted labels must remain bitwise identical to F_base.

base.checkpoint: C_joint: maximum early macro-AUPR among epochs within 1.01 of minimum early oracle macro NMAE

side.checkpoint: minimum early oracle worst-compound-group NMAE; the same rule is applied to G0 and G1 without development labels or thresholds

training.calibration: Fit the F threshold vector solely on calibration identities, apply the CP-safe ISRJ threshold, and reuse it verbatim for G0 and G1.

decision_rule: Only an all-gate development pass permits one pre-registered confirmation run on 1250M. Any development failure freezes this exact method; no scale, CVaR fraction, weight, checkpoint rule, threshold, base architecture, or 1240M outcome may be tuned. A later locked test remains forbidden until two independently generated confirmations pass under the unchanged method.
